content.comment_body: After successfully controlling the [product_name] device via mobile phone on the local Wi-Fi network, the next question arises: How can you operate the [product_name] from a mobile phone or tablet when outside the local Wi-Fi? Is there a detailed tutorial available?
Currently, there are no step-by-step guides for this. However, I recommend considering a VPN solution.

Hello, To set up remote access, configure port forwarding in your router settings. For the external side, set External Port 8080 and Internal Port 8080 to the IP address of the [product_name] device. On your office PC (local side), connect to: [url]:8080 or [url]:8080 if you use dynamic DNS.

Could anyone assist with these settings? (refer to attached image) My [product_name] device's IP: 192.168.1.100 Router's IP: xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx I want to access the web interface of [product_name] from a remote mobile device or tablet over the internet.

I've configured the port forwarding settings, but remote connection isn't working (see attached image). Oddly, when connecting to xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx:8080 from a PC, mobile, or tablet on the same LAN (using cable or Wi-Fi), everything works. But accessing this address from an external network fails. Any suggestions? Note: For this test, security concerns are not relevant.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering challenges with setting up remote access to a [product_name] device from outside their local network. Although local network control is straightforward, remote configuration is hindered by unclear instructions, limited official documentation, and confusion about network settings such as port forwarding and VPN. The community notes a lack of comprehensive tutorials specifically addressing this use case.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy-to-follow, detailed instructions for enabling remote access to the [product_name] device via mobile phone or tablet, covering all necessary router and device configurations for seamless connectivity beyond the local network.
